title: Final-Deployment Release Announcements
summary: HelpDesk updates now announce only once a release is complete, rather than sending the same message after every small deployment.
added: Release announcements are explicitly finalized in deployment notes on the last update commit and then wait three minutes for the deployment to stabilize.
Check #server-logs for an existing announcement of the same version before sending any new message.
changed: Intermediate code pushes and automatic redeployments no longer trigger update messages or founder DMs.
Repeated deployments of the same version do not generate repeat release announcements.
Release announcements are withheld if the bot cannot read the log history, instead of risking duplicate messages.

history.summary: Ticket closure reasons, customer ratings, and downloadable transcripts in #server-logs.
CheckMark reactions on relayed customer DMs and cleaner HelpDesk replies.
Ticket command sync and deployment notification reliability.
